definitions.gloss: illegal transaction; black market deal; underground dealing
definitions.explanation: A transaction conducted secretly and illegally, outside official or regulated channels. Includes black market sales, illicit trading, and under-the-table deals.

examples.japanese: {闇取引|やみとりひき}で{逮捕|たいほ}された。
examples.english: He was arrested for illegal transactions.

examples.japanese: {武器|ぶき}の{闇取引|やみとりひき}が{問題|もんだい}になっている。
examples.english: Illegal arms dealing has become a problem.

examples.japanese: {戦後|せんご}の{日本|にほん}では{食料品|しょくりょうひん}の{闇取引|やみとりひき}が{横行|おうこう}していた。
examples.english: In postwar Japan, black market dealing of food was rampant.

notes: Composed of {闇|やみ} (darkness, secrecy) + {取引|とりひき} (transaction, deal). The prefix {闇|やみ} is productive for illegal/underground activities: {闇|やみ}ルート (illegal channel), {闇|やみ}{金融|きんゆう} (loan sharking), {闇|やみ}{市|いち} (black market). Historically associated with the postwar black market ({闇市|やみいち}). In modern usage, appears in news about organized crime, smuggling, and online illegal sales.
